national_law.name: Decreto legislativo 4 settembre 2024, n. 138
national_law.entry_into_force_note: One of the earliest EU member states to transpose NIS2

competent_authority.name: Agenzia per la Cybersicurezza Nazionale
competent_authority.role: National competent authority, NIS2 oversight and enforcement, digital registration portal management, entity classification, guideline issuance

essential_entities.description: Large enterprises in Annex I high-criticality sectors

important_entities.description: Medium enterprises in Annex II critical sectors

incident_reporting.pre_notification: 24 hours - indicating malicious acts or cross-border impact potential
incident_reporting.initial_assessment: 72 hours - initial assessment report to CSIRT Italia
incident_reporting.final_report: 30 days - comprehensive report covering causes, remediation, cross-border effects

essential_entities_non_public.maximum: EUR 10,000,000 or 2% of worldwide annual turnover, whichever is higher

important_entities_non_public.maximum: EUR 7,000,000 or 1.4% of worldwide annual turnover, whichever is higher

compliance_deadlines.annual_renewal_cycle: Annual: January 1 - February 28 each year (starting January 2025)
compliance_deadlines.acn_entity_list: March 31 - ACN prepares affected entities list
compliance_deadlines.transition_period: 9-18 months from notice receipt for entities identified through December 31, 2025

management_liability.description: Art 23 mandates management body cybersecurity training. Strategic duties including risk management supervision cannot be delegated. Personal liability for security decisions. Training must be completed within 18 months of ACN notification.

sources.title: IAPP - Italy updates National Cybersecurity Framework

notes: Italy was among the first EU member states to transpose NIS2
ACN published implementation framework in April 2025
Registration is an annual recurring requirement (January-February each year)
Italy added unique national sectors in Annex IV (local transport, cultural organizations, etc.)
Public administration penalties are significantly lower than private sector
18-month implementation period from ACN notification for compliance measures
